name: What tools are needed for broken tile replacement?

mainEntity.name: What tools are needed for broken tile replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic tools for broken tile replacement include a hammer and chisel or a rotary tool with a grout removal bit for clearing grout lines. You'll also need a pry bar or scraper for careful tile removal, a trowel for applying thin-set mortar, a notched trowel for spreading it evenly, and a rubber mallet to set the new tile. Safety gear such as gloves and eye protection is essential. For grouting, a rubber float and sponges are necessary. Having a level and measuring tape helps ensure accurate placement and alignment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential tools include a hammer, chisel, trowel, rubber mallet, grout float, and safety gear to remove the old tile and install a new one.
